baseline: K18-D full with identical Front stream and step budget
teacher: R1 on 240 paired Left/Right inputs from 80 training demos, matched physical input, explicit shared draft and time; no evaluation data
prescreen_gate: at most 4 of 20 below parent for Left and Right first correct, and at most 2 of 20 below full for Front terminal; additionally report old terminal preservation
selection: if eligible choose largest minimum of three endpoint ratios, old terminal as tie-break; if no eligible arm report screen and evaluate stronger old replay if feasible
confirmation: candidate vs Full and R1 on separately generated and locked common-grasp simulator states, 20 per instruction
fixed_readout: mu channel drift and d projection, norm, cosine at steps 30, 100, 300, 1000
attribution: real checkpoint additions and withdrawals by layer block; matched raw Front vs old BC and teacher gradients; actual AdamW with history, zero-gradient, and fresh-history controls
